title: Faculty and education-method criteria stated for every continuing education program
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 4.05(1) an applicant for status as a Board-approved provider submits a completed application form for each continuing education program for which approval is sought, and under 4.05(1)(j) the form includes the qualifications of the faculty preparing and teaching the intended program. Under 247 CMR 4.05(5) education methods shall conform to four criteria: learning experiences and teaching methods appropriate to achieve the objectives of the program; principles of adult education used in the design of the program; time allotted for each activity sufficient for the learner to meet the objectives of the program; and facilities and educational resources adequate to implement the program. Under 247 CMR 4.05(6) the faculty shall present documentation satisfactory to the Board indicating competence to teach the content of the intended program and knowledge of the principles of adult education. Unlike 4.05(3) and (4), which open with the delivery format they govern, 4.05(5) and (6) are stated without reference to format.
exam_relevance: Tests which program criteria in 247 CMR 4.05 attach to a delivery format and which are stated for every program, in particular that faculty documentation is not a live-program-only requirement.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: Faculty documentation under 4.05(6) is stated for every intended program; only the credential sentence in 4.05(4) is written for live programs.
verification_notes: Read in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 4.00 on mass.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
